plugin.name: WeatherAlerts
plugin.title: NOAA Weather Alerts (USA)
plugin.desc: Plays U.S. National Weather Service alerts, including non-weather emergencies the NWS relays, on your Squeezeboxes, then restores what was playing. Unofficial, and not affiliated with NOAA. Not a life-safety system: alerts can be late, missed or wrong.
plugin.creator: gitdrk

plugin.desc: After you turn off an alarm, plays today's calendar events and news headlines, spoken and on screen.
plugin.creator: gitdrk
